packing_H3b.budget_source: registry count-score curve (OWNER-REPORTED), not a model

hypothesis: H3: structure at moderate catalogue distance is real; the coarse registry consensus locates it, kernel-disjoint placement and a plateau-scale budget keep it cheap, and only the sub-ridge choice is new

prior.kind: score-weighted dot density of the top 40 registry rasters, Gaussian sigma 20 px (2 km), multiplied by (1 + 0.2 * H1 habitat) as a sub-ridge modulator
prior.scale_note: coarse by construction: 2 km >> the 3 px metric radius, so the region is informed and the exact cells are ours

rejected_priors.H1_geophysics_only: falsified: champion captures 4.6% of its mass vs 5.9% of a uniform field (evidence/wbg8/emit2.json)
rejected_priors.fine_registry_coverage_field: degenerate: 99.98% of dots landed within 3 px of the champion and 0.008% outside the top-25 buffers (evidence/wbg8/emit3.json)

calibration.ceiling_reading: the champion captures only this share of ANY broad field, so under this prior no level can reach 0.2778; that is a statement about the prior, not about the metric

design_rules.K_note: 12,395 is the WBG-6 null-calibration scale of the truth support, HOLDOUT side evidence, and the bar's only free knob

bracket_geometry_only.identity: TP_ours = TP_ref - |G & lost| + |G & gained|; FP_ours = n_ours - hits
bracket_geometry_only.reading: no fitted surface enters this bracket: it is the champion's own measured precision plus the two dot geometries. It still spans the champion score, so the honest statement is 'indistinguishable', not 'better'.

measurement_corrections.nn_px_in_emit2_emit3: those receipts report KD-tree neighbour INDICES under the name nn_min_px/nn_median_px (an upstream copy-paste in scripts/wbg8_emit2.py); the corrected statistic is used here, and no conclusion in this lane changes because the blob verdict rested on connected components and area coverage, which were measured directly

bracket_packing_vs_greedy.note: the greedy allocator truncates at the marginal-value bar; the packing variant spends the whole plateau-scale budget instead
